releases.name: v0.2.1 — Chronological Session Timings
releases.body:
## Chronological Session Timings

- `Session Timings` rows are now sorted oldest to newest, so the sidebar always shows
  the sequence of events.
- Rows without a timestamp stay at the bottom, ordered by lifecycle rank.
- This keeps a real reply-before-input sequence readable without relabeling the rows.

### Install

```bash
opencode plugin add github:ransagy/opencode-session-time#v0.2.1
```

Restart the TUI after installing.

This is a TUI-only plugin for OpenCode V2. Web and desktop clients do not load TUI plugins.

releases.name: v0.2.0 — Session Timings
releases.body:
## Session Timings for OpenCode V2

Fork of [LazyGatto/opencode-session-time](https://github.com/LazyGatto/opencode-session-time)
with a current-turn stopwatch, a historical `Session Timings` sidebar, and relative ages.

### Features

- Prompt-footer stopwatch for the current turn. Starts at the first assistant step after
  the last user input and freezes when the turn completes.
- Sidebar `Session Timings` block: session start, last user input, last model thought,
  and last model reply.
- Relative ages (`just now`, `3m ago`, `2h ago`).
- Thought and reply durations.
- Historical anchors are backfilled from the API and persisted across TUI restarts, so
  long tool-only runs and post-crash sessions still show the last input and reply.
- `/time` panel: assistant turns with start, completion, and duration.

### Install

```bash
opencode plugin add github:ransagy/opencode-session-time#v0.2.0
```

Restart the TUI after installing.

This is a TUI-only plugin for OpenCode V2. Web and desktop clients do not load TUI plugins.

Tested with OpenCode 2.1.4.
